transcript.text: Hi everyone, I wanted to get us together to review the internal platform maintenance train plan for October before I publish it. The train runs across four weeks — October 6-10, October 13-17, October 20-24, and October 27-31. The current draft assigns CI-runner cleanup to week 1, crypto-dependency upgrade to week 2, database-indexing cleanup to week 3, and certificate automation to week 4. Before I finalize, I'd like to go through my standard review with backend, infrastructure, QA, and release coordination in that order so each of you can check the dates and commitments for your area. Who's ready to start with the backend review?

transcript.text: While tracing a separate SDK upgrade yesterday, I confirmed that the payment service still imports the old crypto library. The crypto-dependency upgrade replacement must run in week 1 so downstream SDK validation can begin before the train ends. I haven't updated the maintenance ticket yet because the dependency confirmation came from a local build completed after the ticket was last reviewed.

transcript.text: I found during a cloud-billing reconciliation this morning that exactly 14 idle CI runners are still incurring charges and can be retired safely in week 4 after the active build queues are drained. The runner inventory hasn't been corrected yet because the billing investigation is still open. This is relevant to the CI-runner cleanup scheduling — if cleanup moves to week 1 as Ravi is suggesting, we'd need to account for the fact that those 14 runners can't be safely retired until week 4.
